title: Shinonome Ena — A Bag Full Of Care〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm? I got a message on Nightcord...
Who sent it...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <I'll look over the rough draft of the illustration you sent me. I'm sorry for not noticing your message sooner.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
Kanade's back to work starting today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't know what was gonna happen when she collapsed, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
For now, I'll just say...
<It's okay. Let me know what you think.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She looked a lot better when I saw her over in SEKAI, and Mafuyu gave the go-ahead for her to get back to work. So, I guess everything's fine.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But she just got healthy...
A part of me thinks she's gonna immediately push herself way too hard again.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, I know!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Before you get started, Kanade, can we talk for a bit?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, now I just need to...!
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI
Lake

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Kanade...!
I'll be right over!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see Mafuyu and Mizuki are here too.
Miku and the others too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We heard that you asked Kanade to meet you in SEKAI, so we decided to come stick our noses in♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't mind either way, but Mizuki insisted.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I can picture that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Does that mean Mizuki wrangled you and the others up, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We decided to come after we heard that you'd all be here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm... Should we not have come?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, you guys are fine.
It really isn't a big deal.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It isn't...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Also...
Ena, what's that you're carrying there?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was gonna ask the same question!
That bag looks completely stuffed...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, this?
I came to give these to Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
First, let's start with... This vegetable juice!
It's packed with vitamins, fiber and everything else you need!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Th-Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Next, energy jelly packs!
Supposedly these are loaded with vitamins, so I bought a bunch of different flavors.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, these protein cereal bars, and these high-protein-low-calorie instant noodles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, um...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And here are some sports drinks to keep you hydrated!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I got you a few bottles, since I know you're gonna need more than one. I also got...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
E-Ena, wait...
Just wait a minute...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, sorry!
There's no way you're gonna be able to carry all this stuff, huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Actually, that's okay.
You can just take this whole bag home with you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, that's not what I meant...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I mean, I really appreciate what you're doing, but I feel a lot better now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, you can't let your guard down!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You need to keep eating and drinking stuff that your body needs, at least for a while!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you...
But I don't think I'll be able to get through all of these...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not a problem! They all have really long expiration dates! It's okay for you to stash them away somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Like on a shelf, in your desk drawers or some other place within arm's reach.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You can have these while you work, and they should keep anything bad from happening again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm not gonna lie, Kanade...
I want you to take better care of yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, please take these.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Take them, Kanade.
I mean, I agree with Ena on this one.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I promise to eat and drink these, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Good! Do that for me!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for you, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you gonna be able to carry that bag, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I should be able to... I think...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Mafuyu, you're also welcome to have whatever you like. Stuff like this is nice to have for when you're studying, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'll have some if I feel the need.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, I've accomplished my mission!
Let's return to our rooms and get back to work!
